youtube.title: Why Tennis Balls Are Yellow 🎾 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Tennis balls were traditionally white or black, chosen to stand out against the court. When color television spread, a white ball was hard for viewers to follow, and research showed yellow was easier to see on screen. The International Tennis Federation approved yellow balls in 1972. Wimbledon kept using white until 1986, when it finally switched to yellow.
